purpose: Identify useful cross-check and acquisition leads for foundational statutes. These links are not permission grants and secondary text must not be promoted to primary-source status.

evidence.publisher: Official Gazette 49, 4 Dec 2014; Manshurat PDF image visually inspected
evidence.source_class: official Gazette accession decision and regional treaty text
evidence.observed_title_ar: قرار رئيس الجمهورية رقم 278 لسنة 2014 بشأن الموافقة على انضمام مصر إلى اتفاقية الرياض العربية للتعاون القضائي
evidence.finding: The Gazette image confirms approval of Egypt's accession to the Riyadh Agreement 1983 and the 1997 amendment to Art. 69, subject to ratification. Issuance date is 19 Aug 2014 and Gazette publication 4 Dec 2014. Manshurat metadata says effective 10 Aug 2014, before issuance; a separate listing reports 8 Sep 2014. Riyadh Art. 68 makes accession binding 30 days after deposit; the deposit/entry date must be verified from the Arab League Secretariat before applying Art. 72 supersession of the 1952 agreements.
evidence.next_action: Obtain Arab League accession/deposit record, date of instrument deposit, and any Egyptian reservation/notification. Preserve Law 83/1954 historical until lawyer confirms treaty status and entry into force.

evidence.publisher: Manshurat and MKSEgypt full treaty transcriptions
evidence.source_class: bilateral treaty full text and metadata discrepancy
evidence.observed_title_ar: اتفاقيات التعاون القضائي الجنائي وتسليم المجرمين بين مصر وتركيا والمغرب والمجر ورومانيا
evidence.finding: Several treaty records report entry-into-force dates before Gazette publication: Turkey 222/1989 (2 Jan vs 12 Jan 1992), Hungary 129/1988 (3 Oct 1988 before 17 Nov 1988 publication), Romania 76/2003 (10 Jul 2003 before 28 Aug 2003 publication). Morocco 229/1989 has 7 Nov vs 20 Nov 1997 publication metadata conflict and 11 Sep 1997 entry date. These may reflect international exchange/notification dates, but must not be normalized without the ratification record.
evidence.next_action: Obtain bilateral exchange-of-ratification notes and Gazette issue page images; keep issuance, Gazette publication, international entry into force and domestic commencement as separate fields.

guardrails: A secondary database page is a discovery/cross-check source, not the authoritative publication record.
A label such as 'amended' does not identify every amendment or prove the current consolidated wording.
A text consolidated only through 2020 must be treated as potentially stale for 2026.
Do not bulk download, scrape, or reuse any source without reviewing access terms and permission for the intended use.
Do not promote any entry to acquired, verified, or in-force based only on these leads.
